name: Title Case Converter
description: Convert text to Title Case instantly — every word capitalized, the rest lowercased, entirely in your browser.

faq.question: What exactly does Title Case do here?
faq.answer: It lowercases the whole string first, then capitalizes the first letter of every word — so 'hELLO wORLD' becomes 'Hello World'. It does not apply style-guide rules about skipping small words like 'a' or 'the'; every word's first letter is capitalized.

faq.question: How is this different from Capitalize Words?
faq.answer: Title Case lowercases the rest of each word first. Capitalize Words only touches the first letter of each word and leaves the rest exactly as typed — see the dedicated Capitalize Words tool if that's what you need.
